'''Havath Minor''' was the fifth and outermost<ref name="CE" /> [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Muunilinst (star)|Muunilinst]] in the [[Muunilinst system/Legends|Muunilinst system]],<ref name="GW" /> located in the [[Obtrexta sector/Legends|Obtrexta sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> Havath Minor was a [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] with eleven [[Moon/Legends|moons]].<ref name="GW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The worlds in the [[Muunilinst system/Legends|Muunilinst system]], except [[Muunilinst/Legends|Muunilinst]], were designed for the [[2004]] sourcebook ''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]'', published by [[Wizards of the Coast]] for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="GW" /> Later, the [[2009]] sourcebook ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', co-authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], placed the Muunilinst star system in grid square K-4.<ref name="EAOC" />
